descriptions.inProgress: I asked #p2101006# about the fox, but he didn't seem to know. I took some time wondering what to do... until I realized something and promised #p2101006# to be his friend. He smiled and nodded accordingly, and gave me the book Little Prince. Now I should give this to #b#p2040052##k.
descriptions.completed: When I told #p2040052# I promised to be friends with #p2101006#, he let out a sigh of relief, and thanked me for my gesture. Hopefully this straightened out the distorted part in the book #p2101006#. It feels weird being a part of a folk tale...
